activeQuestion.prompt: Which material may still be used?

options.text: Any individual cover without visible scratches, even from the held batch.
options.zh: 任何沒有明顯刮痕的外蓋，即使來自已停用的批次也可以。
options.whyZh: 管理的是整個受影響批次，不是只擋肉眼看得出刮痕的外蓋。

options.text: Covers from the earlier cleared batch; a clean-looking cover from the held lot still stays out.
options.zh: 可用先前通過檢驗的那批外蓋；已停用批次的外蓋即使看來沒傷也不能用。
options.whyZh: 前一批經檢驗通過可用；受影響的批次即使單件外觀無傷也不能投產。

options.text: Covers from the current batch once Purchasing schedules replacement delivery.
options.zh: 採購排定替換品交貨時程後，就可使用這次到貨的外蓋。
options.whyZh: 排定替換品交貨並不會解禁原本被停用的批次。

options.text: Both batches, provided the supplier submits a report by Tuesday.
options.zh: 只要供應商週二前提交報告，兩批都能用。
options.whyZh: 週二是供應商改善報告期限，不是兩批共同的放行期限。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 前一批經檢驗通過可用；受影響的批次即使單件外觀無傷也不能投產。

group.title: A supplier quality update
group.passage: Our incoming inspection team found scratches on some of the aluminum covers delivered this week. The affected batch has been placed on hold and will not enter production. We have asked the supplier to examine the protective packaging and send a corrective action report by Tuesday. The earlier batch passed inspection and can still be used. Purchasing will coordinate replacement covers once the supplier confirms the delivery schedule. Please report any similar damage through the quality portal.
group.passageZh: 進料檢驗團隊在本週交付的部分鋁製上蓋上發現刮痕。受影響批次已暫停使用，不會投入生產。我們已要求供應商檢查保護包裝，並最遲在星期二提供矯正措施報告。較早的批次檢驗合格，仍可使用。供應商確認交期後，採購會協調替換上蓋。若發現類似損傷，請透過品質入口網站回報。
